statement: The site's media bucket on R2 had no backup or second copy: a deletion, a provider failure or a compromised write key would lose the course media.

treatment.plan: Cut made on 2026-11-18 (D-323 step 2): the media primary is the versioned S3 bucket of the media stack (noncurrent versions 90 days). The R2 buckets were then emptied and deleted (2026-11-18 20:57 BRT) and every Cloudflare API token, the R2 write key among them, was revoked (20:42-20:45 BRT), so no R2 copy or key is left; the second copy is the us-west-2 replica that RISK-media-single-account records.
